## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm run build` passes locally
- [ ] New/changed images are under 300KB and in WebP format
- [ ] If this adds a post: frontmatter matches the schema in `content.config.ts`,
      `author` matches a file in `content/authors`, and any new university/city/tag
      was added to `src/lib/constants.ts` rather than left as free text
- [ ] Facts (fees, deadlines, document lists, processing times) come from personal
      experience or a linked official source — nothing was guessed or scraped
- [ ] This isn't giving legal/immigration advice — it's a personal account
